message.content: It depends on what you’re looking for—genre, critical acclaim, or audience reception—but many critics and audiences agree that **“Parasite”** (2019) was the standout film of 2020. It won the Palme d’Or at Cannes, the Academy Award for Best Picture, and was praised for its sharp social commentary, genre‑blending storytelling, and masterful direction by Bong Joon‑ho. If you prefer something more mainstream, “Tenet” (2020) and “Soul” (2020) were also highly regarded, while “1917” (2019) continued to receive accolades into 2020.
